name: Process Discovery
summary: Adversaries may attempt to get information about running processes on a device. Information obtained could be used to gain an understanding of common software/applications running on devices within a network. Adversaries may use the information from Process Discovery during automated discovery to shape follow-on behaviors, including whether or not the adversary fully infects the target and/or attempts specific actions. analytics.name: Analytic 1804
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Process Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir('/proc/') with recursive listdir by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$ on device with android_version /status or /proc//cmdline by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$].
